name: Fellow Opus 2
details: Electric conical burr grinder; dial 0–10 with fine adjustment for espresso.

notes.batch: Fellow's Aiden batch-brew range; Aiden single-serve is 5–7.

rangeInfo.note: Fellow Opus 2 Getting Started Guide (hosted by a retailer), grind settings chart: espresso 0–2, Prismo 1–3, AeroPress 3–5, pour-over 5–9, French press/cold brew 8–10; Aiden settings: single-serve 5–7, batch brew 7–10. “For darker roasts, select a higher number within the recommended grind range.”
